material.head: Weekly: wave 4 turning up from its zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Mar 27 to Aug 13 (+30%; wave 3 is 1.9 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−1.4% to −3.9%), on lighter volume, with the 38.2% retracement of the Mar 9–Aug 10 rise in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−6.7%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.
